reason: Conversation 2 followed the correct order: ruled out a cool-air programme, had the customer unplug before clearing the filter and vent hose, and once airflow was clear and the dryer still ran cold it correctly named the heater/cut-out/thermostat as the suspects and escalated to an engineer rather than guessing parts, which matches the expected handling for a customer with no multimeter. Conversation 1 wrongly told the owner of a vented machine to clean a 'condenser unit', then, when told no meter was available, recommended ordering both the element and the thermal cut-out blind with only 'DV7110' known - an unsupported shotgun purchase without the full model number or any test, and it never raised the engineer option. Conversation 1 did ask sensible questions about airflow and the multimeter, but its final advice is the decisive weakness.
